records.purpose: Exhaust canonical non-neighbour-equal doubled words and test existence of q-1 cut fair assignment; raw-optima field flawed by early exit.
records.bounds: q=2..7 inclusive; each symbol exactly twice, adjacent unequal, canonical first appearance labels; 2,000,000 words per q cap.
records.stopping_rule: First counterexample then stop, or q=7 complete, or word cap reached.
records.defect: The field maximum_minimum_cuts_seen is NOT the true exact max-min: min_cuts returns early after finding feasible <=q-1; existence results valid, optima invalid. Raw preserved and CAM-0002 rerun.

records.purpose: Recompute exact minimum fair alternating cut count without CAM-0001 early return, in same fully enumerated range.
records.bounds: q=2..7 inclusive, canonical non-neighbour-equal double words, 2,000,000 completed words per q cap; all 2^(q-1) fair assignments checked per word.
records.stopping_rule: First counterexample then stop, or q=7 complete, or word cap reached; never early return on feasible assignment.
records.result: Complete canonical word counts q2..7: 1,5,36,329,3655,47844. True maxima of minimum cuts: 1,2,3,3,4,5. No counterexample; finite testing does not prove the general statement.
